features.method: Reuses the already-sourced approximate campus point for site:lhaaso-haizi-mountain (OpenStreetMap/Nominatim geocode of a rest area on the Haizi Mountain route, precision_m 5000) verbatim; no new coordinate is derived. A tighter value (29d21'27.6"N, 100d08'19.6"E) is repeatedly attributed to the LHAASO Science Book (arXiv:1905.02773) by independent web-search text extracts, but every attempt this session to fetch that PDF/HTML directly (WebFetch, ar5iv, arxiv.org/html, and an r.jina.ai text-extraction proxy) returned only binary/garbled content or a 404 -- the value could not be seen verbatim in a fetched page this session and is NOT used here (see worklog candidate-correction list, flagged unverified). KM2A is independently sourced as circular (radius ~575 m core, ~635 m outer guard ring) and WCDA as 78,000 m2 (two 150x150 m pools + one 300x110 m pool), but neither can be drawn: both would need to be centred on a coordinate precise to well under the shapes' own size, and the only coordinate available this session (precision_m 5000) is far too coarse (geometry-derived-from-coarse-anchor) -- see worklog backlog.
